| `DescendOptions` | Interface | Options for `descend`. | |
| `DescendRecordOptions` | Interface | Options for `descend` under `onUnreadable: "record"`: every `DescendOptions` field, with `onUnreadable` fixed to `"record"`. | |
| `DescendResult` | Interface | `descend`'s success value under `onUnreadable: "record"`: the matched FILE paths plus an `UnreadableDirectory` for every mid-walk directory whose `readDirectory` (or, under `followSymlinks`, a symlinked directory whose `realPath`) failed for a reason other than `NotFound` (a vanished directory stays a benign race in every mode and is never recorded). | |

| `PathEscapeError` | Class | An untrusted relative path would leave, or does not name anything under, the base directory it was confined to. | handle untrusted path escaping a base directory, zip slip, absolute or dot-dot archive entry refused |
| `PathEscapeReason` | Variable + TypeAlias | The decoded type of `(PathEscapeReason:variable)`. | why a confined path was refused, nul byte absolute traversal empty or win32 reserved name |
| `UnreadableDirectory` | Interface | One directory `descend` could not read under `onUnreadable: "record"`: its `cwd`-relative path and the `PlatformError` that `readDirectory` — or, for a symlinked directory under `followSymlinks`, `realPath` — failed with. The cause is the very failure the walk absorbed, so a caller that must report WHY a directory was unreadable never re-reads it. | |
| `Walker` | Class | Upward path traversal primitives: the directory chain from a start path to the root, and first-match scans over it. | walk up parent directories, find nearest config file, ascend to filesystem root |
| `WalkerSyncFileSystem` | Interface | The synchronous file operations the sync walk needs, supplied by the consumer — `node:fs` satisfies it (`nodeWalkerFileSystem` from `@effected/walker/node-sync`). | |
| `WalkerSyncOps` | Interface | The platform half of every sync walk. | |
| `WalkerSyncPath` | Interface | The synchronous path operation the sync walk needs — a structural subset of `node:path`, so the module itself (or its `win32` / `posix` variant) satisfies it. It shapes only the absolute paths handed to the `WalkerSyncFileSystem`; matching is POSIX-relative by the glob contract. | |
| `WalkerSyncStats` | Interface | The stats `WalkerSyncFileSystem` answers — a structural subset of `node:fs` `Stats`, so `statSync` / `lstatSync` satisfy it verbatim. | |
| `compileAndExpand` | Function | Compile a glob pattern and expand it against the filesystem in one call: matching FILE paths relative to `options.cwd`, POSIX separators, sorted. | compile a glob string, expand against the filesystem, pattern to matching files |
| `confineRelative` | Function | Confine an untrusted relative path to a base directory. | confine an untrusted relative path to a base directory as an Effect, reject dot-dot escapes |
| `confineRelativeResult` | Function | Confine an untrusted relative path to a base directory, synchronously. | confine an archive entry or manifest path under a base dir synchronously, zip slip guard, Result |
| `descend` | Function | Expand a compiled glob pattern against the filesystem under `onUnreadable: "record"`, resolving to a `DescendResult` — the matched FILE paths relative to `cwd` (POSIX separators, sorted) plus an `UnreadableDirectory` — path and cause — for every mid-walk directory whose `readDirectory` (or, under `followSymlinks`, a symlinked directory whose `realPath`) failed for a reason other than `NotFound`. The walk continues past each such directory exactly as `"skip"` does; it never aborts and it never discards the offending path or its cause. | expand a compiled glob pattern into files under a directory, prune node_modules |
| `descendEntries` | Function | `descend` under `onUnreadable: "record"`, keeping each match's stat: resolves to a `DescendEntriesResult`. | walk glob matches keeping each file's stat, record unreadable directories |
| `descendEntriesSync` | Function | `descendEntries` under `onUnreadable: "record"`, synchronously over a caller-supplied port. | synchronous glob walk keeping stats, over a caller-supplied fs port |
| `descendSync` | Function | `descend` under `onUnreadable: "record"`, synchronously over a caller-supplied port. | synchronous glob walk over a caller-supplied fs port, no Effect runtime |
| `nodeWalkerFileSystem` | Variable | `WalkerSyncFileSystem` over `node:fs`: `readdirSync`, `statSync`, `lstatSync`, `realpathSync`. | from `@effected/walker/node-sync` — node fs binding for the synchronous walker |
| `nodeWalkerPath` | Variable | `WalkerSyncPath` over `node:path` (the host platform's separator). | from `@effected/walker/node-sync` — node path binding for the synchronous walker |
